8.  GeoDCAT-AP - GitHub
    GeoDCAT-AP is an extension of DCAT-AP for describing geospatial datasets, dataset series, and services. It provides an RDF syntax binding for the union of metadata elements defined in the core profile of ISO 19115:2003 and those defined in the framework of the EU INSPIRE Directive.
    github.com/SEMICeu/GeoDCAT-AP
